g.text: Approve Phase 1 and name the executive sponsor at the October meeting.
The superintendent brings the item; the board votes.
Within two weeks of the vote, the data access request is issued.
In November, the baseline report is delivered.
Before then, we need one named data contact from the district.
Lantern Education Partners and Riverbend Unified are fictional; the
client, prices, dates and projections in this deck are illustrative.
The problem evidence is real and sourced where it appears.

a.tspan: DfE — Working together to improve attendance
